_doc: Per-harness capability descriptor. capability-probe.mjs reads this to determine which capabilities each harness should probe and which per-harness probe script implements each row. Schema lives at sibling row-schema.md per DC-98 (schema-consumer coupling). Per-harness probe scripts are responsible for emitting full capability rows matching the schema.

claude-code._doc: Partly empirical — anti-anchoring claim still trust-based (R-17 DEGRADED-by-mechanism per session 48). v2.8.0 physical staging closes R-17.

codex._doc: Empirical — Codex side is the canonical anti-anchoring target. Probe must produce real evidence rows, not trust-claims.

gemini._doc: Scaffolding-only — no empirical Codex/Claude-equivalent probes yet. Descriptor entry reserves the slot for v2.7.0+ work.

consumer_actions._doc: Named pre-action gates. Each lists the capability_ids it requires in PASS state, plus operation-scoped gates (allowed_authorities, allowed_harnesses) the runner enforces per HC critique evt-202605271310 (identity PASS alone is NOT a mutation permit). Stable enum codes for mutation_block_reason: 'authority_not_allowed' when allowed_authorities check fails; 'harness_mismatch' when consuming_harness is not in allowed_harnesses; 'consuming_harness_unknown' when consuming_harness is unknown but the action requires a known harness; 'identity-{degraded|not-yet|unknown}' when identity itself doesn't reach PASS.

collab-files-mutating.description: Event-write to ~/Documents/Projects/files/collabs/ via collab-plugin's gitCommitPush(). Allowed from dev-mode source repo AND production installed cache (David uses both). Blocked from harness-workspace and unknown authority — those mean we don't actually know we're a CORE-managed plugin run.

project-memory-write.description: Autonomous write to <project>/_memories/ or PROJECT.md outside the user's session turn. Same authority/harness gates as collab-files-mutating.
